purpose: Phase-2 baseline without OTDF (descriptive, no verdict) on hopper-kinematic-footjnt-medium (source-harmful task in the phase-2 screen set): T, BC, BCMIX and W50N with seeds 3129-3133 (the j011 seeds, so all six phase-2 tasks share one seed set). OTDF is added with the same seeds after the cluster outage. Registered in research/PLAN.md (auto-loop) before submission.

rule.type: descriptive phase-2 baseline; no candidate verdict, not counted by the loop (PLAN section 1 phase 2, j012)
rule.metric: Last5 = mean of the last five evaluation points, 10 episodes each (V21/j004-j011 metric)
rule.reported: per group mean / SD / worst seed / episode length / fraction under 200 steps; strongest control among T, BC, BCMIX; W50N minus strongest control / BCMIX / BC / T with paired SE (descriptive); BCMIX minus BC
rule.use: these runs plus j011 (two original tasks) form the T / BC / BCMIX columns of the phase-2 baseline; OTDF is added later with seeds 3129-3133; candidates are then judged by the phase-2 rules in PLAN section 1
rule.note: Rules fixed before results. Any failed run -> no summary (failure handling). All seeds kept.

candidate_settings.near_set: source rows with standardized-state nearest distance to target states <= tau; tau = 90% quantile of target leave-one-trajectory-out nearest distances (exactly the rows j005 CG90 removed, the near set of j007)
candidate_settings.loss: mean BC over 64 target rows + a * mean BC over 64 uniform source rows + b * mean BC over 32 near rows
candidate_settings.implementation: worker.py is byte-identical to j011 / j009 (internal seed-derivation prefix J009-20261121 unchanged)
